title: Amazing tour
text: It was our second time in Barcelona, we had little time and we wanted to remember the city...we thought this would be the best way, and it was a great idea. Our guide's name was Marc, a local guy full of energy who showed us the most emblematic areas of the city for almost 5 hours.
author: Maxbrown80

title: A fabulous Barcelona bike tour
text: Don't miss this tour! Not all cities in Spain are bike friendly, but Barcelona certainly is. We spent 3 hours learning about history, gastronomy and culture with our bike-guide, Antoine, a great guide!
author: angelahE1652IP

title: Yannat
text: We chose the 5h bike tour because we would spend only 1 day in Barcelona and we wanted to describe as much as possible. Our guide was Fabio and we couldn't have been happier.
author: K121CYpedroc
